card.name: Linking words after spelled-out numbers
card.fires_on: The joiner right after a spelled-out number word such as five, two, four or one, such as "-and", "and", "-to", "-e" or "per". It fires where another number or fraction is about to follow.

modes.label: Joiner in number ranges
modes.description: A hyphen or "and" after a spelled-out number, leading into a second number.
modes.example: associated with five<<-and>> eight-fold increases in tacrine C max

modes.label: Fractions and amounts
modes.description: A joiner after a spelled-out number in a fraction or dose, such as "one and one-half" or "one-eighth".

modes.label: Inside number words
modes.description: Partway through a long number word or the start of a percent phrase.
modes.example: one<<-e>>ighth to one-quarter to be injected

card.writes: It promotes digits and the percent sign, and suppresses number-word endings such as teen, ty and hundred, so a numeral is favored next.
card.plain: It marks the spot right after a spelled-out number where a second number is about to come, as in "five and eight-fold".
